messages.subject: ldap groups and shiny
parts:
I'm building an ldap server to manage authentication instead of using flat-file.  I'm trying to figure out the advantages of putting entries in groups in ldap.  In shiny I can use group_search_base, but I'm trying to figure out what the advantages of this are.  For instance, can I use groups for building a shiny application into a multi-tenant application with each company/client having a group and multiple users underneath?  Or is it purely so I can only query members in a certain group on ldap? 

And if I do have a certain group on my ldap server, can I access their group information through the shiny session?

Thank you,
Evan
